official_api_notes.statcan: WDS exposes getFullTableDownloadCSV/{pid}/{language}; full-table CSV/SDMX are official supported extraction routes.
official_api_notes.eurostat: PEEI vintage datasets include a revision-date dimension; IP and unemployment are split between static older vintages and regularly updated recent vintages.

checkpoint_builder.first_release_selection: For each observation period, choose the earliest official vintage that contains a non-missing value for the exact matched series.
checkpoint_builder.asof_selection: At each checkpoint, retain only vintages with revision/release date <= checkpoint.
checkpoint_builder.later_revisions: May enter only at later checkpoints after their publication date.

integrity_gates: Exact unit/seasonal-adjustment/geography match to runtime series.
No silent rebasing comparison of absolute index levels; use growth/impulse where bases differ.
First-release value must be traceable to an official vintage/release date.
Hash/fingerprint the extracted PIT panel before the engine sensitivity run.
Do not modify production payload while constructing validation panel.
